Name: Teleport to Cursor
Author: Pataper
Description:
Tired of walking forever and it's hard to manage your time?
Press [b]V[/b] to teleport to cursor!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Default teleport key: [b]V
[/b]You can change it using [i]config.json [/i]file.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/pa4op/stardew-teleport]Source code﻿[/url]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: CursorTeleport
Manifest.Description: Allows you to teleport your player to current cursor position
